newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Seardel half yr shr slips, div increased.
newsitem.headline: Seardel half yr shr slips, div increased.

text.p: Full name - Seardel Investments Corporation Ltd (clothing footwear and textiles)

NOTE - The group said that it hoped that the rather soft consumer demand in the first half would now improve slightly and adjusted its forecasts for the full year to take into account trading conditions and the acquisition of a controlling interest in Romatex Ltd by the Frame Group Holdings.

It predicted that turnover would be between 2.7 billion rand and 2.9 billion rand, before tax income between 120 million rand and 130 million rand, earnings per share between 37 cents and 43 cents and dividends between 10 cents and 12 cents.
